== Description ==

[[Hayes Hunter]] (left) playing [[Sam Tashima]] (right, red top), with [[Robbie Hendon]] seated at the end of the table and [[Steve Harpster]] (standing back right, grey T-shirt and white beard) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; remaining faces unlabeled.
